snapshot.text: Small public system centred on the Ayres de Menezes Hospital, with complex cases evacuated to Portugal. Construction of a new €32 million reference hospital starts in 2026, and the first cancer screening laboratory opened.

priorities.title: New reference hospital
priorities.text: A €32 million reference hospital, with construction starting in 2026.

priorities.title: Cancer screening
priorities.text: The country's first cancer screening laboratory opened.
